subject: DI03005031

body.en:
Natural or free convection

Fluid motion arises from density differences in a gravitational field, usually produced by heating or cooling. Fluid next to a vertical hot plate becomes less dense and rises; cooler surrounding fluid replaces it. A buoyant circulation develops without a pump. Orientation, temperature difference, fluid properties and characteristic length affect the coefficient.

Forced convection

An external device or imposed pressure difference drives fluid motion, as in a pumped liquid heat exchanger or fan-cooled radiator. Near a wall velocity changes through a boundary layer and temperature changes through a thermal boundary layer. Turbulence usually improves mixing but also increases pressure drop and power demand. If forced flow and buoyancy both matter, the situation is mixed convection.
body.gu:
Natural અથવા Free Convection

Heating અથવા cooling થી density difference થાય અને gravitational field માં તેનાથી fluid motion ઉત્પન્ન થાય તેને Natural/Free Convection કહે છે. Vertical hot plate પાસેનું fluid હળવું થઈ ઉપર જાય છે અને ઠંડું fluid તેની જગ્યા લે છે. Pump વગર buoyant circulation બને છે. Orientation, temperature difference, fluid properties અને characteristic length પર coefficient આધારિત છે.

Forced Convection

Pump, fan અથવા imposed pressure difference fluid ને ગતિ આપે તેને Forced Convection કહે છે; જેમ કે pumped heat exchanger અથવા fan-cooled radiator. Wall પાસે velocity boundary layer તથા thermal boundary layer બને છે. Turbulence થી mixing સામાન્ય રીતે વધે છે, પરંતુ pressure drop અને power demand પણ વધે છે. Forced flow અને buoyancy બંને નોંધપાત્ર હોય તો Mixed Convection કહેવાય.

h.en: Newton’s law and individual heat-transfer coefficient
h.gu: Newton નો નિયમ અને Individual Heat-transfer Coefficient

body.en:
Law and coefficient

Convective heat rate is proportional to exposed area and surface-to-bulk-fluid temperature difference. The individual coefficient h represents one surface/one fluid film. It is not a material constant: flow velocity, flow regime, geometry, fluid properties, orientation and phase change can alter it. The sign of the temperature difference sets the direction; use its magnitude when calculating a positive duty.

Newton law and film resistance
body.gu:
નિયમ અને Coefficient

Convection ની heat rate exposed area તથા surface અને bulk fluid વચ્ચેના temperature difference ને સમપ્રમાણ હોય છે. Individual coefficient h એક surface અને એક fluid film માટે છે. તે material constant નથી; velocity, flow regime, geometry, fluid properties, orientation અને phase change થી બદલાય છે. Temperature difference નો sign દિશા બતાવે છે; positive duty માટે magnitude લો.

Newton નો નિયમ અને Film Resistance

body.en:
Reynolds number

Re compares inertial with viscous effects and helps identify a flow regime. Characteristic length is the pipe diameter for a circular tube; for a noncircular passage use the appropriate hydraulic diameter when the correlation specifies it. A critical value is geometry-dependent, not universal.

Reynolds equation

Prandtl number

Pr compares momentum diffusivity with thermal diffusivity. It is a fluid-property group and indicates the relative spreading of velocity and temperature disturbances.

Prandtl equation

Grashof number

Gr compares buoyancy with viscous effects in natural convection. β is the volumetric expansion coefficient,ν is kinematic viscosity and g is gravitational acceleration. For an ideal gas β is the reciprocal of an appropriate absolute temperature. Use the magnitude of the temperature difference for a positive group.

Grashof equation

Nusselt number and use

Nu expresses the surface heat-transfer coefficient relative to a conduction scale through the fluid. Use fluid conductivity, not tube-metal conductivity. Forced-convection correlations commonly relate Nu to Re and Pr; natural-convection correlations commonly involve Gr and Pr. Use only a correlation valid for the geometry, flow regime and property-evaluation convention.

Nusselt equation
body.gu:
Reynolds Number

Re inertial અને viscous effects ની સરખામણી કરે છે તથા flow regime ઓળખવામાં મદદ કરે છે. Circular tube માટે characteristic length diameter છે; noncircular passage માટે correlation મુજબ યોગ્ય hydraulic diameter લો. Critical value geometry પ્રમાણે બદલાય છે; universal નથી.

Reynolds નું સમીકરણ

Prandtl Number

Pr momentum diffusivity અને thermal diffusivity ની સરખામણી કરે છે. તે fluid-property group છે અને velocity તથા temperature disturbance ના સાપેક્ષ spreading વિશે માહિતી આપે છે.

Prandtl નું સમીકરણ

Grashof Number

Gr natural convection માં buoyancy અને viscous effects ની સરખામણી કરે છે. β volumetric expansion coefficient,ν kinematic viscosity અને g gravitational acceleration છે. Ideal gas માટે β યોગ્ય absolute temperature નો reciprocal છે. Positive group માટે temperature difference નું magnitude લો.

Grashof નું સમીકરણ

Nusselt Number અને ઉપયોગ

Nu surface coefficient ને fluid ની conduction scale સાથે સરખાવે છે. તેમાં fluid ની conductivity લો, tube metal ની નહીં. Forced convection correlations માં સામાન્ય રીતે Re તથા Pr અને natural convection માં Gr તથા Pr વપરાય છે. Geometry, flow regime અને property-evaluation માટે યોગ્ય correlation જ વાપરો.

Nusselt નું સમીકરણ

h.en: 7. Specific heat of air by forced convection
h.gu: 7. Forced Convection થી Air ની Specific Heat

body.en:
Aim

Specific heat of air by forced convection

Principle

A measured air mass flow receives a corrected heat input; its bulk temperature rise gives specific heat. This practical determines cₚ, not h.

Apparatus and connections

Blower/air duct heater, calibrated airflow measurement, inlet/outlet temperature sensors, power meter and interlocks.

Supervised procedure

Check airflow and sensors before heating. Establish the specified airflow and permitted steady heater condition. Record mass flow or calibrated volume flow with density basis, Tin, Tout and heat-loss correction. Repeat only within the approved flow/heater range.

body.en:
Aim

Natural-convection heat-transfer coefficient

Principle

Corrected convective heat from a surface divided by its area and surface-to-ambient difference gives h. Radiation is a separate loss.

Apparatus and connections

Natural-convection plate or tube rig, heater, surface/ambient sensors and power meter; specified exposed area.

Supervised procedure

Shield from unintended drafts as SOP permits. Record orientation, ambient and averaged surface temperatures at steady state. Apply the rig’s radiation/end-loss correction before calculating h; report its assumptions.

Blank observations—actual readings required

Geometry/orientation:____; A(m²):____; Ts, T∞(°C):____; power(W):____; radiation/end loss(W):____

Calculations

Result and safe fault-finding

Actual result:____; units:____; uncertainty/repeats:____; apparatus SOP:____.No experimental result is supplied. Use hot-surface guards. Without a loss correction, the calculated value is an apparent combined coefficient, not pure natural-convection h.
body.gu:
હેતુ

Natural-convection Heat-transfer Coefficient

સિદ્ધાંત

Corrected convection heat ને area તથા surface-to-ambient difference થી ભાગતાં h મળે છે.Radiation અલગ loss છે.

Apparatus અને Connections

Natural-convection plate અથવા tube rig, heater, surface/ambient sensors, power meter તથા specified exposed area.

Supervised Procedure

SOP મુજબ unintended drafts અટકાવો.Orientation, ambient તથા averaged surface temperatures steady state પર નોંધો.h કાઢતાં પહેલાં rig ની radiation/end-loss correction લો અને assumptions જણાવો.

ગણતરી

Result અને Safe Fault-finding

વાસ્તવિક result:____; units:____; uncertainty/repeats:____; apparatus SOP:____.અહીં કોઈ experimental result આપેલ નથી. Hot-surface guards વાપરો.Loss correction વગરનું value apparent combined coefficient છે, pure natural-convection h નહીં.

body.en:
Aim

Forced-convection heat-transfer coefficient

Principle

Forced flow transfers heat between the wall and bulk fluid. The fluid calorimetric heat rate or correctly allocated electrical heat determines h.

Apparatus and connections

Assigned forced-flow tube/duct rig, flowmeter, wall/bulk sensors, heater and calibrated power/temperature measurement.

Supervised procedure

Verify flow direction and sensor locations, establish permitted steady operation and record bulk inlet/outlet and surface temperatures. Use the assigned bulk-mean or local model consistently. Compare calorimetric and electrical duties without double-subtracting losses.

Blank observations—actual readings required

Flow:____;ṁ(kg s⁻¹):____; Tin, Tout, Ts(°C):____; A(m²):____; corrected heat(W):____; bulk-mean basis:____

Calculations

Result and safe fault-finding

Actual result:____; units:____; uncertainty/repeats:____; apparatus SOP:____.No experimental result is supplied. Maintain minimum safe flow and interlocks. Ambient temperature is not the bulk-fluid mean for a warming internal stream.
body.gu:
હેતુ

Forced-convection Heat-transfer Coefficient

સિદ્ધાંત

Forced flow માં wall અને bulk fluid વચ્ચે heat transfer થાય છે.Fluid calorimetric heat rate અથવા યોગ્ય allocated electrical heat પરથી h મળે છે.

Apparatus અને Connections

Assigned forced-flow tube/duct rig, flowmeter, wall/bulk sensors, heater તથા calibrated meters.

Supervised Procedure

Flow direction તથા sensor locations તપાસો.Permitted steady state પર bulk inlet/outlet તથા surface temperatures નોંધો.Assigned bulk-mean અથવા local model consistent રાખો.Calorimetric તથા electrical duties સરખાવો; losses બે વાર subtract ન કરો.

ગણતરી

Result અને Safe Fault-finding

વાસ્તવિક result:____; units:____; uncertainty/repeats:____; apparatus SOP:____.અહીં કોઈ experimental result આપેલ નથી. Minimum safe flow તથા interlocks જાળવો.Heated internal stream માટે ambient temperature ને bulk-fluid mean તરીકે ન લો.
